reason: I already post every flyer on Instagram and stories, my friend handles it and the PR guys fill the lists, and it works well enough. An app nobody uses yet doesn't give me anything extra, and my competitors will be on it too.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? The app isn't even public yet, so who is actually going to open it? Nobody is using it, and I would be paying after the free month for an audience that doesn't exist.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real users in my area already opening it on a Friday night, or a proven number of people coming through the door from it, and a free tier with no 3-month minimum.
